{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats remain committed to ending poverty and enabling all Americans to live up to their potential.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The official poverty rate, as measured and communicated by the federal government, fails to capture critical needs like housing, education, health care, transportation, energy, and other necessities, and therefore understates the true share of Americans living in poverty.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support the 10-20-30 funding approach, to direct at least 10 percent of federal funding to communities where 20 percent or more of the population has been living below the poverty line for 30 years or longer.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Directing more federal investment to the communities most in need will help create jobs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Directing more federal investment to the communities most in need will help improve and expand housing.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Directing more federal investment to the communities most in need will help modernize and expand transportation, clean water, wastewater, energy, and broadband infrastructure.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Directing more federal investment to the communities most in need will help promote shared prosperity.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will raise the minimum wage to $15 an hour.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will guarantee equal pay for women.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Raising the minimum wage to $15 an hour and guaranteeing equal pay for women will pull millions of families out of poverty.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will make it easier for working families to benefit from targeted tax breaks, including the Earned Income Tax Credit and the Child Tax Credit.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Earned Income Tax Credit and the Child Tax Credit are too often unclaimed by the lowest-income tax filers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will significantly expand affordable housing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will build new public housing for the first time since the 1990s.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will guarantee Section 8 benefits to all who qualify.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Expanding affordable housing, building new public housing, and guaranteeing Section 8 benefits will help reduce housing costs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Expanding affordable housing, building new public housing, and guaranteeing Section 8 benefits will increase housing availability for low-income families.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
